title: Bahrain FM demands Security Council action after Iranian attacks

snapshot.title: Bahrain FM demands Security Council action after Iranian attacks
snapshot.description: NEW YORK: Bahrain’s foreign minister flew to New York on Thursday to demand action from the UN Security Council after what he described as a “renewed and treacherous” Iranian attack on his country this week, as the US and Russia clashed sharply over responsibility for the escalation.
